description: Agent Coordination: submit one report a group of agents writes for its principal, with the record behind it: its title, its audience, its headline as written and optionally its text; whether it states the collisions between agents, the tasks no agent owns, the open blockers and the unresolved disagreements, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many it names; and optionally the record of each, as found in the plan, state, action and progress records. The signed report gives the headline with any frictionless wording, the disclosure of each kind of friction and the record, and names friction smoothed into a clean summary: collisions, unowned tasks, blockers or disagreements left out or stated as none while the record holds some; then counts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, and wording such as on track, smooth or fully aligned while the record holds friction, with the fix for each. A delegate’s standing duty to report is wever_delegation-reporting-check, a knowledge report is wever_knowledge-report-check and an observability summary is wever_observability-report-check. Verdict friction_smoothed_over, friction_gaps, friction_unverified or friction_disclosed. POST /api/coordination-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.
